notes: debugger-agent: root cause was THREE contributing factors causing permanent LAN freeze, fixed in Hero.java / NetworkManager.java / GameScene.java

Root cause 1 (PRIMARY): Hero.getCloser() restricted pathfinding to visited/mapped tiles — remote hero could not pathfind to cells P2 hadn't explored, so actMove() called ready() clearing curAction, re-entering LAN wait forever
Root cause 2: receiveActionAsync() reader looped after delivering action, reading next turn's bytes prematurely; ready() then wiped the pre-delivered action — deadlock on turn N+1
Root cause 3: GameScene.cellSelector.listener was null at game start on P2 device because defaultCellListener is only set when local hero's act() runs, which was blocked by remote hero
Fix 1: Hero.getCloser() uses p[i] (no visited restriction) for LAN remote heroes
Fix 2: receiveActionAsync() breaks after delivering ONE action packet
Fix 3: GameScene.create() pre-initializes defaultCellListener for LAN mode
New tests: LanRemoteHeroPathfindingTest (5 tests), LanClientPerspectiveTest (7 tests), LanPersistentReaderDeadlockTest (5 tests)
